ruleDefinitions.name: Run Once Task Configuration in Registry
ruleDefinitions.description: Rule to detect the configuration of Run Once registry key. Configured payload can be run by runonce.exe /AlternateShellStartup Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Active\\ Setup\\\\Installed\\ Components.*") AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\StubPath$")) AND  NOT ((Details = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Google\\\\Chrome\\\\Application\\\\.*") AND Details = RGX(".*\\\\Installer\\\\chrmstp\\\.exe\\"\\ \\-\\-configure\\-user\\-settings\\ \\-\\-verbose\\-logging\\ \\-\\-system\\-level.*")) OR ((Details = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\\\Edge\\\\Application\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\\\Edge\\\\Application\\\\.*")) AND Details = RGX("\\\\Installer\\\\setup\\\.exe\\"\\ \\-\\-configure\\-user\\-settings\\ \\-\\-verbose\\-logging\\ \\-\\-system\\-level\\ \\-\\-msedge\\ \\-\\-channel\\=stable$")))
